column1: # v131072 is the update's title version; a .nup carries no control data to name a display version
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (rtld is not listed, as on the other profiles; the survey's "what" column says what each is)
# unconfirmed: the probe's RomFS listing holds the 20 largest top folders (TerrainArc/..., Tex, Model, ...) and System/ is not one of them; the Android flow does not read it
# the engine family's set, as Donkey Kong Bananza and Mario Kart World; the probe reads no file headers, so unmeasured until the first pack
# The NPDM declares 48 MB of system resource (virtual address memory on, as Mario Kart World's 64 MB): nninitStartup sets the heap to the free application memory less a fixed
# reserve. The first phone boot held Mario Kart World's map (heap 6.20 GB, alias fills as the family's). The alias region carries the engine's streaming allocator (main+0x7ed630):
# in Kokiri Forest it maps up to +4.5-4.75 GB of address regions (the Mac/iOS host, which measured this map over runs of the same build: alias 8 GB, the reserve grown by the same
# 5.6 GB so the heap keeps its size). With 2.38 GB there the loader retries what does not fit, the OptimizeChangeBanc thread spins a whole core, and after 5-15 minutes outdoors
# VammManager::AllocateAddressRegion fails and the game aborts (the Mighty Green Kokiri Kid fork) - the phone's 4 GB region would buy minutes, not hours. The reservation is
# address space: physical pages commit only as the game touches them. If the phone's RAM pins, DM_ALIAS_SIZE=0x98000000 in env.txt goes back to a small region
# A map that would take the process past the application pool fails with ResultLimitReached, as on Horizon: the SDK's allocator keeps freed pages mapped until a map fails, then
# gives them back. Without it the Mac/iOS host's PR #1444 reports crashes entering Hyrule Castle, Kakariko Village and Death Mountain and a black screen leaving the Deku Tree
# agl wraps its depth clears in render conditions, as on Donkey Kong Bananza and Splatoon Raiders: in Kokiri Forest the main opaque pass tests EQUAL against a copy of the prepass
# depth that a conditional clear (skipped on the console) wiped first, so no lit geometry landed and the full-screen sky showed through (a white scene) - the Mac/iOS host's finding,
# Handheld: the game presents 1920x1080 instead of the docked 2560x1440 the 1440p phone window would ask for - the same mode the iPhone runs (44% fewer pixels against the same GPU)
# Counter timestamps by segment (vka_exec.c): the game's dynamic resolution reads the GPU time between the frame's timestamp reports, as on Donkey Kong Bananza and Breath of the
# Wild (the same EPD engine family); with one time a submission it reads about 0 and holds the full render size
# Present snapshots by default (the launcher's Frame buffering overrides), as the Mac/iOS profile
# The rewriter's frame step (patches.py FRAME_STEP) follows the game's own frame-rate controller (main+0x3b4f074, interval and fps from the host's step), so the launcher's Frame
# rate setting offers 30 and 60 and the game's 30 fps mode steps its time by the interval; 60 is the profile's default, the launcher's own setting wins where it is set
# measured by the phone split (the Prepare job, 2026-11-07): it cut ps/vs/cs_effect.bin (from /Effect/), ps/vs/cs_shader.bin (from /Shader/) and ps/vs/cs/ts/ms_other.bin
# (the rest: /Lib/, /Layout2Shader/, main); no /UI/ sources exist, so the UI group yields nothing (kept, as the family's row)
